title: No main-content region as a bypass target
user_impact: Keyboard users have no reliable target to bypass repeated navigation blocks.
technical_impact: No element with role="main" (implicit via <main> or explicit) present.

checks.source: Best practice: WAI-ARIA 1.2 main role; ARIA11; axe landmark-one-main (bypass itself is headings/none, SC 2.4.1)
checks.applicability: Every top-level document. A body without any content has nothing to structure and is not applicable.
checks.expectation:
Flags a document without a rendered main landmark (main element or
role="main", also inside an open shadow root), at the html element. While a
modal dialog is open the absence concerns the moment of measurement: review
instead. A hidden second main does not stand in for nor block the visible one.
Best practice without a criterion; a missing bypass mechanism is
headings/none.

failing.html:
Page without a main landmark

No main element or role="main" anywhere on this page.
